title: Exact recovery by the sparse spectrum learner
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers with $n>0$, and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$. Regard $f$ as a function on $\\mathbb F_2^n$ using the coordinatewise binary-to-sign encoding. If at most $2^{k+1}$ of its Fourier coefficients are nonzero, then running the positive exact sparse spectrum learner with parameters $n,k$ and oracle $f$ produces a hypothesis whose evaluation equals $f$ at every input.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
The associated function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ has at most $2^{k+1}$ nonzero Fourier coefficients
